newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL PALM OIL ENDS MIXED AT CLOSE, AWAITS PORLA.
newsitem.headline: KL PALM OIL ENDS MIXED AT CLOSE, AWAITS PORLA.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICALS

PALM OIL FUTURES - Ended mixed on the slight recovery of the ringgit. July crop estimates by private forecaster Ivan Wong had no impact and players were waiting for the PORLA July data at 0430 GMT on Friday. Traders were also cautious over Indonesia's move to abolish rupiah intervention and conversion bands. Oct futures support at 1,230 and resistance at 1,265.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL- Held steady with business among CPOs.
